description: This script sets up manufacturing data in an ERP system, including workstations, assets, items, product bundles, and item prices, using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: setup_data
methods.description: Initializes manufacturing setup by importing JSON data, creating workstations, assets, items, product bundles, and item prices, then commits and clears cache.

methods.name: setup_workstation
methods.description: Creates predefined workstations with random hourly rates and working hours.

methods.name: show_item_groups_in_website
methods.description: Sets the 'show_in_website' flag for the 'Products' item group.

methods.name: setup_asset
methods.description: Loads asset data from JSON, creates Asset documents, assigns purchase and depreciation dates, and submits them.

methods.name: setup_item
methods.description: Loads item data from JSON, creates Item documents, and assigns default warehouses and company info.

methods.name: setup_product_bundle
methods.description: Creates a product bundle with specified items.

methods.name: setup_item_price
methods.description: Deletes existing item prices and inserts new prices for various items in buying and selling price lists.
